risks: Missing-key generation can leave old Fernet tokens unreadable under a new key
Root/backend precedence can conceal which preserved key each encrypted value needs
Prefix-only writer check can double-encrypt quoted ciphertext
In-place environment rewriting lacks inspected atomic publication or rollback
Untracking/replacing a key neither migrates ciphertext nor removes old copies
